summary: Daughter of the Grub family of Williams Township, Pennsylvania, twice married, to Johannes Ihrie and George Stecher; John's 5th-great-grand-aunt.
bio: Maria Magdalena Grub was born on 6 May 1759 in Williams Twp and died on 27 December 1801. She married first, about 1778, Johannes Ihrie (1754–1788), and second, about 1790, George John Stecher (1764–1830); her children were born at Easton from 1779. Her father's will names her as "Mary (m. George Stacher)", and a Pennsylvania cemetery record calls her Maria-Magdalena Grube Stecher. She was John's 5th-great-grand-aunt.

Maria Magdalena (Grub) Ihrig/Stecher (1759-1801); named 'Mary (m. George Stacher)' in her father's will.

FamilySearch gives Maria Magdalena the dates 6 May 1759 to 27 Dec 1801. It names her two husbands as Johannes Ihrie (1754-1788), whom she married about 1778, and George John Stecher (1764-1830), married about 1790, and has children born at Easton from 1779. A Pennsylvania cemetery record calls her 'Maria-Magdalena Grube Stecher' ([R4-S1]).
